prompt: Using Files.readAllLines() crashes on a large log file. Why?
choices: Files.readAllLines() does not support large files
Files.readAllLines() loads the entire file into memory as a List — large files cause OutOfMemoryError
readAllLines() requires the file to be UTF-8 encoded
The method is deprecated for files > 1MB
explanation: readAllLines() reads the entire file into a List<String> in memory. A 10 GB log file would require 10+ GB of heap. Fix: use Files.lines(path) which returns a lazy Stream<String>, processing one line at a time.
